title: What She Kept
summary: The untold half of the myth. Niamh alone in the valley after Oisin rides out, speaking to someone who is not there. Single-character piece; reuses the tir_na_nog staging, so it costs no extra plates.

scenes.visual: Wide shot. The princess stands alone and small in the green valley of silver waterfalls, facing away toward the far end of it. Static camera, low horizon.

dialogue.line: You have been gone one day. I have counted it. You would find that funny.

scenes.visual: Medium shot from the waist up, reverse angle, the pools and green mountainside behind her. She speaks to no one. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Nobody here has ever waited before. I do not think there is a word for it in this language.

scenes.visual: Three-quarter shot from the waist up, seen from the side, warm light across her face. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I told you the years were patient. I did not tell you that I am not.

scenes.visual: Medium shot over the shoulder, her back three-quarters to camera, looking down the length of the valley. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Everyone I have ever known is still here, and still exactly as they were. That is the whole trouble with it.

scenes.visual: Close-up, reverse angle. The princess's face fills much of the frame, the valley a soft blur behind her, her eyes steady. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I have never once been afraid here. Not once, in all the time there has been. And I sent you out and told you not to put your feet down, and now I am.

scenes.visual: Three-quarter shot from the waist up, the green valley wide and bright behind her. She looks toward the way he went. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Come back and I will learn to count. I will learn it properly.
